name: round-8-data-composition-and-tier1-ratings-2026-10-11
selection: Improve aggregate earlier winner accuracy by at least 0.5 percentage points; no accuracy regression in either fold; Brier regression at most 0.002 in each; highest accuracy then lowest mean Brier
promotion: No automatic promotion; new independent future results required
excluded_leagues_basis: Destiny IDs 18959/17233, Space IDs 19201/16110, Ultras ID 18867 contain 9725 of 18231 earlier maps. This tests dataset composition; it does not label these matches as fixed or fraudulent.

candidates.name: exclude_small_leagues_training
candidates.hypothesis: Prevent three prolific league families from dominating learned hero and pair weights while retaining full past rating history

candidates.name: exclude_small_leagues_both
candidates.hypothesis: Fit and calibrate on the remaining pro competitions without making classification claims about omitted leagues

candidates.name: tier1_independent_ratings
candidates.hypothesis: Separate causal team/player/player-hero ratings from verified main Tier 1 events complement global ratings

candidates.name: tier1_ratings_clean_training
candidates.hypothesis: Combine a less concentrated fitting sample with independent Tier 1 player and team history

candidates.name: tier1_only_stronger_shrinkage
candidates.hypothesis: Smaller Tier 1 samples need stronger shrinkage of rarely observed hero pairs than the earlier C=0.15 variant

guardrails: Exclusions affect fitting/calibration only; final coverage remains all 442 Tier 1 maps
Target ratings update only after an earlier confirmed result plus 60 seconds
Tier 1 definition requires exact league ID and event date window
Current-map result cannot enter either rating history
Final-era tournament identities are predefined by the established scope; outcomes are not used to choose events
The live model and existing forecasts remain unchanged
